body.name: piecewise diffusion Poisson construction
body.construction: Set \(F_0(x)=\int_{-\infty}^xu\pi_0(u)\,du\) and \(h_0'(x)=-F_0(x)/(q_0\pi_0(x))\). Set \(F_\gamma(x)=\int_{-\infty}^x(u-m_\gamma)\pi_\gamma(u)\,du\) and \(h_\gamma'(x)=-F_\gamma(x)/(q\pi_\gamma(x))\). Choose each additive constant so its solution has stationary mean zero.
